events.title: Warpack is in Steam Next Fest! Come join us in the demo

events.title: Big item rework: one of each item per unit
events.summary: ITEMSOne of each item per unit. Nine cells are nine different things, so a bag is built, not stackedNo item counts your board. Combos pay more, and on many items a combo unlocks a verbSCRAPS: after every other fight, take one of four cheap Common items for free - Item tags are two layers: what the item is, and whose line it belongs to - Every Legendary is two forges deep. One half of its recipe is forged or Rare - A unit splits once a battle, however many Wraithglass Mirrors it carries

events.title: Oaths rebuilt, swallow capped, sudden death at 20s
events.summary: OATHS Five oaths per commander, all open from round one. Keep them in any order. Every ask and its reward sits on the card under FIGHT. Click it to open THE OATHS. Win streaks are gone. OATHS KEPT counts on your profile. SWALLOW A unit swallows at most 2 traits on top of the ones it is born with. When a meal offers more than fits, a small card asks which ones land. Boards where every unit carried every trait won 87% of their fights past round 8, and a game with one best build stops being a game.

events.title: v0.9.10 - network fix
events.summary: Small patch, no gameplay changes. If your connection is slow or flaky, the game could silently fail to upload your armies and match results. The uploads were too big and gave up after 4 seconds without ever retrying. We spotted it in the telemetry: one player's armies were reaching the pool while his match results never arrived, not once. Fixed three ways: uploads are now about a fifth of the size, they get proper time to finish, and anything that still fails is saved and sent again later.

events.title: Update 0.9.9 - You Can Hear the Kills
events.summary: A crowded fight was mud. You could not hear a kill happen in one. I went and counted. A full board was firing around 25 sounds a second, and up to eight identical sword swings landed in the same frame. Everything that actually tells you something, deaths, spells, revives, was buried under that by about ten to one. Sounds now cap per type. Two swings at a time instead of eight. Your ear only resolves two or three of them anyway, the rest was mush that ate all the headroom. Swings count as backgro

events.title: Update 0.9.7 - A Beat Before the Charge
events.summary: Battles now open with both armies standing still for a moment. It changes more than I expected it to. Thanks to everyone playing. Most of this came out of match data again. Both armies hold their opening formation for about a second before anyone moves. Fights used to start already in motion, so there was never a moment to see who was on the board or what you were about to watch. Units shove each other around less. events.title: Update 0.9.5 - A Proper Welcome
events.summary: Most of this patch came from watching new players try the game. Special thanks to Tim for a pile of feedback. 1,500 recorded battles told us exactly where new players struggle. Here's everything, properly listed: Added a welcome screen on first launch — a short intro with HOW TO PLAY and TO WAR buttons. The full manual no longer auto-opens. Rebuilt HOW TO PLAY as a six-tab handbook: The Run, Gold, Feed, Backpack, Combat, Tips. Added diagrams: feeding a unit into the same unit (= one whole level)
